lty.title: Leave types
lty.description: The kinds of leave of a company: how each is counted, whether it is paid, and its colour. How much leave people get and every limit are set in Leave rules, not here.
lty.denied: You may not see leave types.
lty.readOnly: The system is read-only now, so nothing can be added or changed.
lty.loadError: The leave types could not be loaded
lty.loadError.body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, tell your administrator.
lty.empty.body: Add the kinds of leave your company gives. Nothing is added for you.
lty.empty.filtered.body: Change the filter or the search to see more.
lty.col.name: Name
lty.retire.title: Retire {name}?
lty.retire.body: People can no longer apply for a retired type. Balances and past leave stay as they are, and you can bring the type back at any time. A leave type is never deleted.
lty.restored: The leave type is active again.
lty.form.code.help: Letters, digits, underscore, dot and hyphen. Fixed once the type is used.
lty.form.paid.choose: Choose whether the leave is paid or unpaid.
lty.form.deduct: Unpaid leave is deducted from pay
lty.form.counting.help: Fixed once the type is used. Counting in hours goes with taking it in hours.
lty.form.unit.help: Fixed once the type is used.
lty.form.colour.help: One of the product's colours, written in words as well. Never a free colour.
lty.warn.paid.title: Before you change pay settings
lty.warn.paid: Changing whether a type is paid or an unpaid deduction is not refused by the system even after the type has been used; payroll reads past periods with the new flag. Change it only before first use.
lty.warn.fixed: The code, how the type is counted and the unit it is taken in are fixed once the type is used; the server refuses the change.
lrl.title: Leave rules
lrl.description: The rules of the company's leave policy, one block for each leave type it lists: how leave is given, carried forward, paid out, limited and who may take it. No number is filled in for you.
lrl.denied: You may not see the leave policy of this company.
lrl.readOnly: The system is read-only now, so nothing can be changed.
lrl.loadError: The leave rules could not be loaded
lrl.loadError.body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, tell your administrator.
lrl.noType: The leave policy type is not available
lrl.noType.body: This installation has no leave policy type. Tell your administrator.
lrl.empty: This company has no leave policy yet
lrl.empty.body: Until a leave policy applies to them, employees cannot take any leave. Create one in Policies.
lrl.empty.link: Create a leave policy in Policies
lrl.rules.title: Rules by leave type
lrl.versions.none: This policy has no version yet
lrl.readonly.active: This version is in force and cannot be edited. To change the rules, start a new draft: it is a copy you can edit.
lrl.draft.created: A new draft was started from the active version.
lrl.draft.activate: This is a draft: it changes nothing until it is activated. Activate it in Policies, where the date it starts and any approval are set.
lrl.draft.unsaved: There are changes that are not saved yet.
lrl.blocks.none: This version lists no leave type, so nobody under it can take any leave.
lrl.block.empty: No rule is set for this leave type.
lrl.block.unknown: The code {code} is not one of this company's leave types. The server refuses the save until it is.
lrl.unlisted.title: Leave types this policy does not list
lrl.unlisted.body: Employees under this policy cannot take these leave types: {types}.
lrl.section.entitlement.help: The amount and how it is granted or accrued.
lrl.section.prorata.help: What joiners and leavers get, and how amounts are rounded.
lrl.section.carry.help: What can be carried to the next year and what can be paid out.
lrl.section.negative.help: How far below zero a balance may go.
lrl.section.notice.help: How early leave must be asked for and the longest leave at a time.
lrl.section.eligibility.help: Who the leave is open to.
lrl.section.combine.help: Whether holidays between leave days count, and the leave types that cannot be taken together.
lrl.section.approval.help: Who must approve and when compensatory off expires.
lrl.section.other.help: Other rules of this leave type.
lrl.applies.title: Who does this apply to
lrl.applies.help: The leave policies are tried from the top; the first rule that fits an employee decides which leave policy they get. Assignments are changed in Policies.
lrl.applies.needsManage: The list of employees who would get no leave policy is shown to people who manage policies.
lrl.applies.unmatched.error: The list of employees without a leave policy could not be worked out now.
lrl.applies.unmatched.note: These employees cannot take any leave until a rule covers them.
lrl.applies.resolution: Which policy applies to this person?
